name: led_sign
description: Offline LED sign web app for phones, rendered by a Zig WebAssembly core

paragraphs: A scrolling LED marquee for your phone that runs entirely on the device. Type a message, tap Show, and hold the phone up. No account, subscription, analytics or server-side processing; messages and settings stay in the browser.
Pick any hue, square or round LEDs, five font styles, speed and LED size. Messages can blink, repeat, run mirrored or inverted, and be saved or shared as a link that opens straight into the sign.
The renderer is written in Zig and compiled to a 3 KB WebAssembly module. A thin HTML/CSS/JavaScript layer handles the page, storage and browser features.
features: Messages wider than 8192 LED columns are refused with an explanation rather than shortened.

Automated: native Zig tests, model tests, tests against the compiled WASM, and headless Chromium tests that inspect rendered canvas pixels for uniform square and circular LEDs in portrait, landscape and several device…
Not yet verified: Safari on a real iPhone (rendering, Home Screen install, rotation, wake lock, offline). Until that happens, no iOS behavior should be considered confirmed.
